title: Approval policy has an unusually large number of approvers

maxApprovers.text: Approvers above which the control loses meaning

report.title: {Items.Count} approval {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy has', 'policies have')} more than {params.maxApprovers} approvers

messages.businessImpact: When most administrators can approve, approval becomes a formality rather than a check, and accountability for a change becomes hard to establish.
remediation: Reduce the approver group to a small number of people who are accountable for the operation.
messages.cannotSee: A policy whose approver groups could not be read is passed over rather than counted as having none.
